Original:
This is a work-in-progress demo of Bits & Bops
and may not be representative of the final product.
Translated:
Dette spil er en ufærdig demo af Bits & Bops
og repræsenterer muligvis ikke det endelige produkt.

Original:
You can join our Discord server at
tempolabgames.com/discord
to report crashes or bugs, give feedback,
or simply hang out with our lovely community.
Translated:
Du kan deltage i vores Discord server på
tempolabgames.com/discord
for at rapportere problemer, give feedback,
eller bare for at hænge ud.

Original:
If you can't use Discord, you can also email
support@tempolabgames.com
and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
Translated:
Hvis du ikke kan bruge Discord, så kan du også skrive til
support@tempolabgames.com
og vi vil svare så hurtig som vi kan.

Original: Your copy of the Bits & Bops demo is out of date.
Translated: Din kopi af Bits & Bops demoen er udløbet.

Original:
Please open the game via Steam
while you are connected to the internet
to automatically update the game files.
Translated:
Vær venlig at åbne spillet med Steam
mens du er forbundet til internettet
for at automatisk opdatere dine spil filer.

Original:
You can use the itch.io app available at
itch.io/app
to keep the demo up to date,
or download a new version manually.
Translated:
Du kan bruge itch.io appen som er tilgængelig på
itch.io/app
for at undgå at demoen udløber,
eller manuelt downloade en ny version.

Original: The Bits & Bops demo must be launched via Steam.
Translated: Bits & Bops demoen skal køres med Steam.

Original:
It looks like your audio isn't configured correctly,
and the game can't run without it.
Translated:
Det ser ud til at din lyd ikke er konfigureret rigtigt,
og spillet kan ikke køre uden det.

Original:
We'll switch you to the Fallback engine
to get you unstuck. Press any key to quit,
then relaunch the game.
Translated:
Vi skifter dig til Fallback motoren
for at løsrive dig. Tryk på enhver knap for at afbryde,
derefter skal du køre spillet igen.

Original:
If you're still having trouble,
head over to our Discord at
tempolabgames.com/discord
and let us know in the bug reports channel.
Translated:
Hvis du stadig har problemer,
så deltag i vores Discord server på
tempolabgames.com/discord
og oplys os om dit problem i #bug-reports kanalen.

Original:
If you're not able to fix this error,
head over to our Discord server at
tempolabgames.com/discord
and let us know in the bug reports channel.
Translated:
Hvis du ikke kan løse dette problem,
så kom med i vores Discord server hos
tempolabgames.com/discord
og fortæl os om problemet i bug reports kanalen.

Original:
It looks like something has gone wrong.
This is a bug that a developer will need to fix.
Translated:
Det ser ud til der er noget som er gået galt.
Det her er et problem som en spiludvikler skal fikse.

Original:
Please report this problem to us at
tempolabgames.com/discord
in the #bug-reports channel.
Translated:
Vær venlig at rapportere dette problem på
tempolabgames.com/discord
i #bug-reports kanalen.

Tryp på hvilken som helst knap for at fortsætte

Original:
You can use them to fine-tune the game's performance,
but not every setting will work well on your computer.
Translated:
Du kan bruge dem til at forbedre spillets ydeevne,
men det er ikke garanteret at alle indstillingerne vil virke på din enhed.

Original:
Misconfiguration can cause audio crackling
and visual stuttering.
Translated:
Fejlkonfiguration kan føre til knitrende lyd
og hakkende billeder.

Original: If you get stuck, use the <color=#5AD0FF>Reset to default</color> option!
Translated: Hvis du sidder fast, tryk på <color=#5AD0FF>Nulstil til standard</color> knappen!

Original: Reset all options on all pages to their default values.
Translated: Nulstil alle indstillinger på alle sider til deres standard værdier.

Original: Use this if you've got yourself into a mess!
Translated: Brug det her hvis du er kommet i noget værre rod!

Original: Press {Action.Confirm} to confirm and restart now.
Translated: Tryk på {Action.Confirm} for at bekræfte og genstarte nu.

Original: Control how the game is rendered to the screen.
Translated: Kontrollér hvordan spillet er gengivet på skærmen.

Original: Whether to run the game in full screen mode.
Translated: Om spillet skal være i fuldskærm eller ej.

Original: The game uses the entire screen with no border.
The game uses a bordered window.
The resolution of the game window.

Translated: Om vertikal synkronisation skal slåes til.

Original: The game renders and displays complete frames in sync with your display.
Translated: Spillet gengiver og viser komplette billeder synkroniseret med din skærm.

Original: This does not negatively impact input latency.
Translated: Det her har ikke negativ indflydelse på input latens.

Original: This may negatively impact input latency.
Translated: Det her kan muligvis havde dårlig inflydelse på input latens.

Original: The game generates frames independently of your display, which may result in tearing.
Translated: Spillet generer billeder uafhængigt af din skærm, som kunne resultere i rivning.
Det her kan muligvis forbedre input latens.

Original: The maximum number of complete frames to queue.
Translated: Det maksimale antal af komplette billeder som skal stå i kø.

Original: Lower values mean lower visual latency, but may cause visual stuttering if your computer can't keep up.
Translated: Lavere værdi giver lavere visuel latens, men kan få din enhed til at hakke hvis den ikke er god nok.

Original: The maximum rate at which the game generates frames.
Translated: Den maksimale frekvens hvor spillet generer billeder.

Original: Higher values use more power and drain battery faster on portable devices.
Translated: Højere værdier bruger mere batteri på bærbare enheder.

Original: Control how audio is delivered to your sound card.
Translated: Kontrollér hvordan lyd er sendt til dit lydkort.

Original: The overall volume of all sound output by the game.
Translated: Den generelle lydstyrke af alt lyd fra spillet.

Original: The volume of all menu and in-game music.
The volume of all menu and in-game sound effects.
Which audio device to output to.
Routing through a software mixer will increase overall latency.
Translated: At køre igennem en software mixer vil øge generel latens.

Original: Audio is output to the system default device.
Translated: Audio is output to the system default device.

Original: Audio is sent to this device via WASAPI.
Translated: Audio is sent to this device via WASAPI.

Original: Audio is sent to this device via miniaudio.
Translated: Audio is sent to this device via miniaudio.

Original: Audio is sent directly to this device driver.
Translated: Audio is sent directly to this device driver.

Original: Settings are configured via your device driver's control panel.
Translated: Settings are configured via your device driver's control panel.

Original: How audio is delivered to your sound card.
Translated: Hvordan lyd er sendt til dit lydkort.

Original: Writes directly to your sound card for lower latency. May not work with some sound cards, and not compatible with other programs including screen recorders.
Translated: Kører direkte på dit lydkort for lavere latens. Det virker muligvis ikke på nogle lydkort, og kan ikke bruges med andre programmer inkluderende skærmoptagere.

Original: Writes directly to your sound card. This may prevent other programs from playing or recording audio.
Translated: Kører direkte på dit lydkort. Der er risiko for at forhindre andre programmer i at afspille eller optage lyd.

Original: Generally offers the best compatibility, but has higher audio latency.
Translated: Har den bedste kompatibilitet, men også højere lyd latens.

Original: This value should not be changed in shared mode.
Translated: Denne værdi burde ikke ændres i delt lydindstilling.

Original: Lower values mean lower audio latency, but will cause fuzzing or crackling if your computer can't keep up.
Translated: Lavere værdier giver lavere lyd latens, men kunne medføre til knitrende lyd hvis din enhed ikke er god nok.

Original: Whether to strictly enforce the audio buffer size.
Translated: Om lydbufferen skal strengt tvinges eller ej.

Original: The buffer size is strictly enforced.
This may cause stuttering or crackling if your audio output device can't handle the buffer size.
Translated: Det her kan muligvis medføre til hakning og knitrende lyde hvis din lydenhed ikke kan håndtere buffer størrelsen.

Original: The buffer size is a request that can be overridden by your audio output device.
Translated: Buffer-størrelsen er en anmodning som kan blive tilsidesat af din lydenhed.
Dette kan muligvis medføre til mere lyd latens.

Original: How the audio thread decides when to run.
Translated: Hvordan lyd tråden beslutter sig for hvornår den skal køre.

Original: This performs better on most computers.
Translated: Det her kører bedre på de fleste enheder.

Original: Only use this if you experience problems with Timer.
Translated: Brug kun det her hvis du oplever problemer med Tidtæller.

Original: How the audio thread's priority is set.
Translated: Hvordan lyd trådens prioritet er sat.

Original: Only use this if you experience problems with Standard.
Translated: Brug kun det her hvis du oplever problemer med Standard.

Original: Size of the buffer to use when rendering audio.
Translated: Størrelsen af bufferen brugt når lyd gengives.

Original: Settings that prioritise latency will cause fuzzing or crackling if your computer can't keep up.
Translated: Indstillinger som prioriterer latens vil medføre til knitrende lyd hvis din enhed ikke er god nok.

Original: Control how the game reads key and button presses.
Translated: Kontrollér hvordan spillet modtager tryk på taster og knapper.

Original: Control how the game reads button presses.
Reassign buttons to customize input in games and menus.
Translated: Genindstil knapper for at lave skræddersyet input i spil og menuer.

Original: Press {Action.Confirm} to bind a button to this action.
Translated: Tryk {Action.Confirm} for at binde en knap til denne handling.

Original: Press a button to bind it to this action.
Translated: Tryk på en knap for at binde til denne handling.

Original: {Button} is the last button bound to {Action}.
Translated: {Button} er den sidste knap bundet til {Action}.

Original: Control how the game displays button names.
The driver the game uses to talk to your keyboard and mouse.
Translated: Driveren som spillet bruger til at snakke med dit tastatur og mus.

Original: Only use this driver if the Custom driver does not work.
Translated: Brug kun denne driver hvis den Specialiserede driver ikke virker.

Original: The driver the game uses to talk to your controllers.
Translated: Driveren som spillet bruger til at snakke med dine controllere.

Original: Uses the Simple DirectMedia Layer library, which is compatible with many different controllers.
Translated: Bruger Simple DirectMedia Layer, som virker med mange forskellige controllere.

Original: Specifically built for this game and may give better performance in some circumstances.
Translated: Specifikt bygget til dette spil og kan muligvis give bedre ydeevne i nogle tilfælde.

Original: Whether to lock the mouse cursor to the game area.
Translated: Om musemarkøren skal låses til spilvinduet.

Original: The mouse cursor is locked to the game area when the mouse is used during gameplay.
Translated: Musemarkøren er låst til spilvinduet når musen er brugt under gameplay.

Original: The mouse cursor can move freely.
Change various game behaviours to tailor the experience to your individual needs or taste.
Translated: Du kan ændre visse spiladfærd for at forbedre din oplevelse.

Original: The language to use for text in the game.
Translated: Sproget som bruges til spillets tekst.

Original: This is a fan translation contributed by {Translators}.
Translated: Det her er en fan oversættelse bidraget af {Translators}.

Original: The engine the game uses to talk to your hardware.
Translated: Motoren som spillet bruger til at snakke med dit hardware.

Original: Specifically built for this game and gives the best performance.
Translated: Specifikt bygget til dette spil og giver den bedste ydeevne.

Original: Only use this engine if the Custom engine does not work.
Translated: Brug kun denne indstilling hvis den Specialiserede motor ikke virker.

Original: This setting requires a restart. Press {Action.Confirm} to restart now.
Translated: Du skal genstarte for at anvende denne indstilling. Tryk {Action.Confirm} for at genstarte nu.

Original: Whether to use a simplified control scheme.
Translated: Whether to use a simplified control scheme.

Original: Use a simplified single-button control scheme during gameplay.
Translated: Use a simplified single-button control scheme during gameplay.

Original: Use the default multi-button control scheme during gameplay.
Translated: Use the default multi-button control scheme during gameplay.

Original: Whether to schedule hit sounds to enable audio latency compensation.
Translated: Om input lyde skal forudsendes for at aktivere latens kompensation.

Original: Hit sounds always play perfectly on time.
Translated: Input lyde spiller altid perfekt til tiden.

Original: This is only recommended if you are using a high latency audio device, for example Bluetooth headphones.
Translated: Det her er kun anbefalet hvis du bruger en enhed med høj latens, f. eks Bluetooth høretelefoner.

Original: Hit sounds are only played on player input.
Translated: Input lyde er kun spillet på spiller input.

Original: Amount to offset scheduled sounds to compensate for audio latency.
Translated: Mængde forskydning af forudsendte lyde for at kompensere for lyd latens.

Original: Press {Action.Confirm} to begin automatic audio offset calibration.
Translated: Tryk {Action.Confirm} for at automatisk begynde lyd forskydning kalibrering.

Original: Audio offset has no effect when scheduled hits are disabled.
Translated: Lyd forskydning har ingen indflydelse når forudsendte lyde er slået fra.

Original: Whether to include whole-screen flashing or flickering effects.

Translated: Alle skærm effekter er slået til.

Original: Some flashing or flickering may still occur. Immediately stop playing and consult a doctor if you experience symptoms of epilepsy.
Translated: Blitz eller blinkende billeder kunne muligvis stadig ske. Stop med at spille med det samme hvis du oplever syptomer af epilepsi og snak med en læge.

Original: Whether to read text using text-to-speech.
Translated: Om tekst burde læses op eller ej.

Original: Most game text will be read using text-to-speech.
Translated: Det meste spil-tekst vil blive læst op.

Original: This is not compatible with exclusive mode audio on some systems.
Translated: Det her virker ikke med eksklusiv lyd på nogle systemer.
Oplæsning af tekst er slået fra.

Original: Whether to describe what is happening during gameplay.
Translated: Om det der foregår under gameplay skal beskrives.

Original: Scenes and actions will be described by your screen reader during gameplay.
Translated: Scener og aktioner vil være beskrevet af din skærmoplæser under gameplay.

Original: You may need to configure your screen reader to not interrupt text when buttons are pressed.
Translated: Du skal måske konfigure din skærmoplæser til at ikke afbryde tekst når knapper trykkes.

Original: No narration will occur during gameplay.
Whether to demonstrate the required action in tutorials up-front.
Translated: Whether to demonstrate the required action in tutorials up-front.

Original: All required actions in tutorials will be demonstrated before you are given a chance to attempt them.
Translated: All required actions in tutorials will be demonstrated before you are given a chance to attempt them.

Original: The required actions in tutorials will only be demonstrated after failing.
Translated: The required actions in tutorials will only be demonstrated after failing.

Translated: En anden række valgmuligheder dukker op.

Join our Discord community
for mods and custom mixtapes!
Translated:
Deltag i vores Discord
for at spille mods og custom mixtapes!

Original:
Please wishlist & follow us on Steam
and social media to support the game!
Translated:
Vær venlig at følge og sætte os på din ønskeliste på Steam
og følg os på sociale medier for at støtte spillet!

to be notified when Bits & Bops releases!

Scene: A sparkling blue ocean under a pale blue sky. In the bottom left corner of the frame, an orange cat wearing red shorts and holding a camera stands on the deck of a small boat. The boat bobs gently up and down in the water.
Translated: Scene: Et belyst blåt hav under en bleg blå himmel. Nede i det venstre hjørne ses en orange kat der har røde shorts og holder et kamera på dækket af en lille båd. Båden hæver sig op og ned på vandet.

Original: This seal loves to bop the beach ball.
Translated: Denne sæl elsker at slå næsen ind i denne badebold.
Tryk på {Action.Primary} for at tage et billede!

Original: Next: Bubbles appear in the water, then a purple seal emerges with a splash. A multicoloured beach ball descends from the top of the frame. The seal bops the beach ball back into the air with his nose.
Translated: Næste: Bobler kommer op til overfladen, og en lilla sæl dukker frem med et plask. En flerfarvet badebold falder ned på sælens snude, hvor den så skubber badebolden op i vejret igen.

Original: Make sure you take the photo right as he hits the ball.
Translated: Vær klar på at tage billedet lige når han rammer bolden.

Original:
Sometimes he likes to juggle the ball.
What a show-off!
Translated: Nogle gange kan han godt lide at jonglere med bolden. Sikke en pralehans!

Original: When you hear the bell, get ready to snap three photos in a row.
Translated: Når du hører klokken, så vær klar på at tage tre billeder efter hinanden.

Original: Watch the ball for the timing!
Translated: Kig på bolden for at se timingen!

Original: Next: A ship's bell sounds and the cat whips his head left and right. The seal emerges from the water and bounces the ball twice, then bops it back into the air on the third hit.
Translated: Næste: Et skibs klokke ringer og katten drejer sit hovedet til begge sider. Sælen dukker frem fra vandet og jonglerer bolden to gange på snuden, og derefter sender den langt op i vejret igen.

Original: Not quite. Remember: three bops, three photos.
Translated: Det kan du gøre bedre. Husk: tre slag, tre billeder.

Original: Keep an eye on the ball for the timing. You've got this!
Translated: Hold øje med bolden for at se timingen. Jeg tror på dig!

Original:
Whoa there! You've got an itchy trigger finger!
Try slowing down a little.
Translated:
Hov hov hov! Du er godt nok klar på aftrækkeren!
Prøv at gøre det lidt langsommere.

Original: Make sure you wait for the seal to touch the ball before you snap those photos.
Translated: Vent indtil sælen rører bolden før du tager de billeder.

Original: Great! Now get out there and snap some photos!
Translated: Super! Lad os få taget nogle billeder!

Original: Wispy clouds drift over palm trees on sandy islands.
Translated: Skyer svæver over palmetræerne på sandede øer.

Original: The camera pans down to bring the orange cat into frame.
Translated: Kameraet gå ned for at tage katten med i billedet.

Original: The boat drifts left carrying the cat out of frame.
Translated: Båden flyder til venstre og tager katten ud af billedet.

Original: The boat drifts back showing the cat is gone. A seagull stands atop the camera on a tripod.
Translated: Båden flyder tilbage som viser at katten er væk. En måge står ovenpå kameraet på en tripod.

Original: The cat floats in from the right on an inflatable tube. He is wearing sunglasses and holding a hotdog.
Translated: Katten flyder ind fra højre mens den ligger i et oppusteligt rør. Han har solbriller på og han har en hotdog i hånden.

Original: The cat returns to the boat.
Translated: Katten vender tilbage ombord på båden.

Original: The cat and seal switch places.
The cat and seal switch back.
The cat takes the place of the ball.
The ball pops on the seal's nose. The seal slowly slinks back into the water.
Translated: Badebolden går i stykker på sælens snude. Sælen synker langsomt ned i vandet.

Original: The cat has fallen into the sea and dropped his camera.
Translated: Katten har faldt ned i havet og tabt sit kamera.

Original: The cat shows the seal a photo and they both smile.
Translated: Katten viser sælen et foto og de smiler begge to.

Original: Two photos of the cat and seal having fun together sit on the sand.
Translated: To fotoer af katten og sælen som hygger sig sammen ligger på sandet.

Original: You can't always get the perfect shot.
Translated: Man kan ikke altid havde det bedste billede.
De her billeder passer lige ind i en god billedebog.

Original: You captured memories that will last a lifetime!
Translated: Du har fanget nogle minder som vil vare for livet!

Original: I hope you're going to pay for all that film.
Translated: Jeg håber at du vil betale for al den film.

Original: Scene: A plain background with line art resembling an instruction manual. To the left of the frame, a piece of wood sits idle. To the right of the frame, a hammer has just driven a nail into another piece of wood.
Translated: Scene: En enkel baggrund med stregkunst der ligner en vejledning. Til venstre står der et stykke træ. Til højre har en hammer lige slået et søm i et andet stykke træ.

Original: I'll put the nails down, and you hammer them in.
Translated: Jeg skal nok lægge sømmene ned, og så skal du slå dem i.

Original: Next: A hand appears from the top left to place nails into pieces of wood as they move across the scene from left to right.
Translated: Næste: En hånd dukker frem op til venstre for at placere søm i nogle stykker træ mens de bevæger sig på scenen fra venstre til højre.

Original: We'll never get anything built this way.
Translated: Vi kommer aldrig til at bygge noget som det står til lige nu.

Original: Listen out for the rhythm when I put them down, then hammer them in as they go past.
Translated: Lyt til rytmen når jeg lægger dem ned, og slå dem i når de kommer forbi dig.

Original: Hmm... it looks like a lot of these nails are bent to the left.
Translated: Hmm... der ser ud til at mange af disse søm er bøjet til venstre.

Original:
When that happens, you're hitting them too early.
Try waiting a little longer.
Translated:
Når det sker betyder det at du slå dem i for tidligt.
Prøv at vente lidt mere.

Original: Looks like you're still hitting them too early.
Translated: Det ser ud til at du stadig slå dem i for tidligt.

Original:
Relax, and wait for the nails to come to you.
You can close your eyes if it helps.
Translated:
Slap of og vent indtil at sømmene kommer til dig.
Du kan lukke dine øjne hvis det hjælper.

Original: These instructions get pretty complicated, so make sure you keep an ear out for the change in rhythm.
Translated: Vejledningen kan godt være lidt indviklet, så vær klar på at skifte rytme når det kommer til stykket.

Original: An instruction manual sits slightly askew on a wooden table.
Translated: En vejledning sidder skråt på et bord lavet af træ.

Original: The camera zooms in to make the top two boxes fill the frame.
Translated: Kameraet zoomer ind for at få de øverste to kasser til at fylde billedet.

Original: The blocks move smoothly from box 1 to box 2.
Translated: Klodserne bevæger sig elegant fra kasse 1 til kasse 2.

Original: The camera cuts to show more of the table.
Translated: Kameraet klipper for at vise mere af bordet.

Original: The camera cuts back and forth between close-up shots of the hand and hammer.
Translated: Kameraet klipper frem og tilbage mellem nærbilleder af hånden og hammeren.

Original: The camera zooms out to show a white cat sitting on the instruction manual.
Translated: Kameraet zoomer ud for at vise en hvid kat som sidder på vejledningen.

Original: The camera cuts between multiple rotated angles.
Translated: Kameraet klipper mellem mange forskellige vinkler.

Original: The camera shows the cat on the instruction manual again.
Translated: Kameraet viser katten på vejledningen igen.

Original: The cat sits on top of the manual obscuring view of the hammer.
Translated: Katten sidder ovenpå vejledningen som blokerer for hammeren.

Original: The camera settles. Blocks disappear from box 1 and reappear later in box 2.
Translated: Kameraet står stille. Klodser forsvinder fra kasse 1 og dukker op senere i kasse 2.

Original: The camera returns to the starting view.
Translated: Kameraet vender tilbage til den første billedomskæring.

Original: The cat has climbed under a pile of loose wooden boards.
Translated: Katten har klatret under en bunke løse brætter træ.

Original: The cat watches a TV which sits atop a new cabinet.
Translated: Katten kigger på et fjernsyn som sidder ovenpå et nyt skab.

Original: The cat sits on top of a newly built cabinet.
Translated: Katten sidder ovenpå et skab som var bygget for nyligt.

Original: I hope this is covered under warranty.
Translated: Jeg håber det her har garanti.

Original: This looks like it will hold together.
Translated: Det ser ud som om at det står fint!

Original: It looks just like the picture!
Translated: Det ligner billedet på en prik!
Vi havde ikke brug for et trykluftbor.

Original: Scene: The interior of a house with pale green floral wallpaper. To the left of the frame, an open window shows greenery outside, and a blue radio sits on the windowsill. To the right of the frame, a yellow canary sits on a perch.
Translated: Scene: Inden i et hus der har lysegrønt tapet med blomster på. Til venstre ses der et åbent vindue der viser naturen udenfor, og en blå radio sidder i vindueskarmen. Til højre sidder en gul kanariefugl på en siddepind.

Original: Listen for the question, then tap {Action.Primary} to respond.
Translated: Lyt efter spørgsmålet, og derefter tryk på {Action.Primary} for at svare.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio. Subtitles showing "Tweet tweet" in blue and "tweet" in yellow appear at the bottom of the screen. A bouncing ball in the shape of Bop's face bounces evenly across the three words.
Translated: Næste: Pippelyde spiller fra radioen. Undertekster der viser "Pip pip" i blåt og "Pip" i gult dukker frem fra bunden af skærmen. En hoppende bold som er formet som Bops ansigt hopper fra ord til ord.

Original: Not quite. Watch for the timing, and don't jump in before your turn.
Translated: Ikke helt sådan. Vær opmærksom på timingen, og lad være med at svare før det er din tur.

Original: Excuse me, you're talking over the question!
When you hear tweet tweet, you answer tweet.
Translated: Når du hører pip pip, svarer du pip.

Original:
Conversation is best when allowed to flow naturally.
Try the same question without the bouncing ball.
Translated: Samtaler har det godt af når ting kan naturligt flyde sammen.<page>Prøv det samme spørgsmål uden den hoppende bold.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio as before, but this time no lyrics or bouncing ball appear. If you're hearing this, that may not make a difference to you.
Translated: Næste: Pippelyde spiller fra radioen som før, men denne gang er der ikke nogle undertekster eller hoppende bold. Hvis du hører dette gøre det nok ikke nogen forskel for dig.

Original: Not quite. Concentrate on the timing, same as before. You can close your eyes if it helps.
Translated: Ikke helt sådan. Koncentrér på timingen, ligesom før. Du kan lukke dine øjne hvis det hjælper.

Original: When you hear tweet tweet tweet, you wait a little before answering.
Translated: Når du hører pip pip pip, så skal du vente lidt før du svarer.

Original: Canary thinks carefully about complicated questions.
Translated: Kanariefugle tænker sig godt om når det kommer til komplicerede spørgsmål.

Original: Tap {Action.Primary} to respond after a short delay.
Translated: Tryk på {Action.Primary} for at svare efter at havde ventet lidt.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio. Subtitles showing "Tweet tweet tweet" and a dash in blue and "tweet" in yellow appear at the bottom of the screen. A bouncing ball in the shape of Bop's face bounces quickly across the three blue words, then evenly to the dash and the final yellow word.
Translated: Næste: Pippelyde spiller fra radioen. Undertekster viser "Pip pip pip" og en bindestreg i blåt og "Pip" i gult på bunden af skærmen. En hoppende bold som er formet som Bops ansigt hopper hurtigt over de tre blå ord, og ligeså til bindestregen og det sidste gule ord.

Original: Excellent! Now let's try this one without the bouncing ball.
Translated: Super! Lad os nu prøve det uden den hoppende bold.

Original: Next: Tweet sounds play from the radio as before, but this time no lyrics or bouncing ball appear. If that didn't make a difference to you last time, it won't make a difference to you this time either.
Translated: Næste: Pippelyde fra radioen spiller som fra før, men denne gang er der ingen undertekster eller hoppende bold. Hvis det ikke gjorde en forskel for dig sidste gang, vil det ikke gøre en forskel denne gang.
Fantastisk! Det er som om du var født til at snakke!

Original: Now if only there were someone to talk to...
Translated: Bare hvis der var én man kunne snakke med...

Original: The window blind is down and the room is dim.
Translated: Vinduets gardin er nede og rummet er mørkt.

Original: The blind lifts to reveal a blue wren on the windowsill where the radio previously sat.
Translated: Gardinen løfter sig for at afsløre en blå gærdesmutte på vindueskarmen hvor radioen sad før.

Original: The birds talk about their home lives. The wren raises a family and the canary eats chips.
Translated: Fuglene snakker om deres hjemmeliv. Gærdesmutten opdrager en familie og kanariefuglen spiser chips.

Original: The birds talk about their exercise routines. The wren flies outside and the canary gives up on lifting weights.
Translated: Fuglene snakker om deres trænings rutiner. Gærdesmutten flyver udenfor og kanariefuglen giver op på at løfte nogle vægte.

Original: The birds talk about their diets. The wren forages for food and the canary gets ice cream from the refridgerator.
Translated: Fuglene snakker om deres kost. Gærdesmutten leder efter mad og kanariefuglen får en is fra køleskabet.

Original: The birds talk about music. The wren sings with her friends and the canary sings with the radio.
Translated: Fuglene snakker om musik. Gærdesmutten synger med sine venner og kanariefuglen synger med radioen.

Original: The birds talk about each other. They have enjoyed their conversation.
Translated: Fuglene snakker om hinanden. De har nydet deres samtale.

Original: Canary sits on the couch alone with a bag of chips.
Translated: Kanariefuglen sidder på sofaen helt alene med en pose chips.

Original: The birds share a bag of potato chips.
The birds joyfully fly high in the sky together.
Translated: Fuglene flyver højt op i himmelen med glæde i deres selskab.

Original: Seems something was lost in translation.
Translated: Ser ud til at der var en misforståelse.

Original: That's enough chit-chat for one day.
Translated: Det er nok snakken for i dag.

Original: You've got a real way with words!
You made a friend for life!
Translated: Du har fået en ven for livet!

Original: Try letting someone else speak occasionally.
Translated: Lad være med at afbryde andre når de snakker.

Original: An auditorium with an array of large speakers and unlit lights affixed to the scaffolding. A yellow robot stands in the centre of the stage, with two female backup dancers standing behind him to his left and right. The dancers are wearing sneakers and trackpants with sideways yellow caps.
Translated: An auditorium with an array of large speakers and unlit lights affixed to the scaffolding. A yellow robot stands in the centre of the stage, with two female backup dancers standing behind him to his left and right. The dancers are wearing sneakers and trackpants with sideways yellow caps.

Original: Listen up, crew! We've got moves to learn!
Translated: Listen up, crew! We've got moves to learn!

Original: When we clap three times, tap {Action.Primary} four times to dance with us.
Translated: When we clap three times, tap {Action.Primary} four times to dance with us.

Original: Next: The backup dancers clap above their heads, then throw out their hands alternating to the left and right.
Translated: Next: The backup dancers clap above their heads, then throw out their hands alternating to the left and right.

Original: Not quite — we clap three times, you dance four times.
Translated: Not quite — we clap three times, you dance four times.

Original: Press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin, and release to freeze!
Translated: Press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin, and release to freeze!

Original: Watch for the one-two cue, then show us your moves!
Translated: Watch for the one-two cue, then show us your moves!

Original: Listen for the one-two record scratch, then show us your moves!
Translated: Listen for the one-two record scratch, then show us your moves!

Original: Next: The backup dancers throw up their elbows, then spin rapidly on the ground, before finally freezing with one hand planted on the ground and legs splayed in the air.
Translated: Next: The backup dancers throw up their elbows, then spin rapidly on the ground, before finally freezing with one hand planted on the ground and legs splayed in the air.

Original: Not quite — watch for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.
Translated: Not quite — watch for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.

Original: Not quite — listen for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.
Translated: Not quite — listen for the signal to get ready, then press and hold {Action.Secondary} to spin and release to freeze.

Original: Red curtains part to reveal the stage. The overhead lights flash in an alternating pattern.
Translated: Red curtains part to reveal the stage. The overhead lights flash in an alternating pattern.

Original: The stage lights shine neon pink, and lights on the speakers flash with the melody.
Translated: The stage lights shine neon pink, and lights on the speakers flash with the melody.

Original: The lights are cut and the stage lights flash neon green.
Translated: The lights are cut and the stage lights flash neon green.

Original: The stage lights flash neon orange.
Translated: The stage lights flash neon orange.

Original: The dancers strike a relaxed pose on the ground.
Translated: The dancers strike a relaxed pose on the ground.

Original: The dancers fiddle with wires in the robot's head.
Translated: The dancers fiddle with wires in the robot's head.

Original: The trio kneel triumphantly on the stage.
Translated: The trio kneel triumphantly on the stage.

Original: The robot is carried by a cheering audience.
Translated: The robot is carried by a cheering audience.

Original: Seems there are still a few bugs to work out.
Translated: Seems there are still a few bugs to work out.

Original: Looks like you're set to double time.
Translated: Looks like you're set to double time.

Original:
Thank you for playing the
Bits & Bops Kickstarter demo!
Translated:
Tak for at spille
Bits & Bops Kickstarter demoen!

Original:
Beat all three stages in a row
to go for a high score!
Translated:
Gennemfør alle tre baner efter hinanden
for at gå efter et high score!

Original: Accessibility has been enabled. To disable, press Shift+{Key}+A
Translated: Tilgængelighed er slået til. For at slå fra, tryk Shift+{Key}+A

Original: Accessibility has been disabled. To re-enable, press Shift+{Key}+A
Translated: Tilgængelighed er slået fra. For at slå til igen, tryk Shift+{Key}+A

Original: Here, let me start the metronome...
Translated: Her, lad mig tænde for metronomen...

Original: All you have to do is tap {Action.Primary} in time with the metronome. It's that simple!
Translated: Alt du skal gøre er at trykke {Action.Primary} sammen med metronomen. Så simpelt er det!

Original: Just keep going until we get a good reading.
Translated: Bliv bare ved indtil vi får en god aflæsning.

Original: Looks like your total delay is {Delay}ms.
Translated: Ser ud til din totale forsinkelse er {Delay}ms.

Original: This number should only be negative if your true delay is small and you're tapping a little early.
Translated: Dette tal burde kun være lille hvis den rigtige forsinkelse er lille og du trykker lidt for tidligt.

Original:
If that's the case, you probably don't need to calibrate.
I'll set your offset to 0ms.
Translated:
Hvis det er tilfældet, så behøver du nok ikke at kalibrere.
Jeg vil sætte din forskydning til 0ms.

Original: I'll apply this offset whenever you have scheduled hits enabled in the settings.
Translated: Jeg vil sætte denn forskydning når du forudsendte lyde slået til i indstillingerne.

Original: Since your delay is relatively small, you may enjoy the game more if you disable scheduled hits.
Translated: Siden din forsinkning er relativt lille, så vil du nyde spillet uden forudsendte lyde.

Original: Since your delay is relatively large, you may enjoy the game more if you enable scheduled hits.
Translated: Siden din forsinkning er relativt stor, så vil du nyde spillet med forudsendte lyde.

Original: By the way, it's a good idea to recalibrate any time you change your input or audio device.
Translated: I øvrigt, der er en god idé at genkalibrere når du skifter input eller lyd enhed.

Original: Feel free to come back and recalibrate any time!
Translated: Du må meget gerne komme tilbage for at genkalibrere hvornår som helst!
